title: Can AI beat a naive portfolio? An experiment with anonymized data
subtitle: Finance Research Letters v. 78 2025
authors: Marcelo S. Perlin, Cristian Foguesatto, Fernanda Muller, Marcelo Righi
description: Presentation evaluating the performance of Google's Gemini 1.5 Flash in making investment decisions using 30,000 simulations over 20 years of anonymized U.S. market data, published in Finance Research Letters.
